steps.title: Draw one line
steps.instruction: Type the changed lines, then press Run. The turtle starts in the center, facing right.
steps.explain: forward(100) moves 100 units in the direction the turtle faces. The pen starts down.
steps.expected: One teal line to the right.
steps.question: What would forward(60) change?
steps.answer: It would draw a shorter line.
steps.help: Compare the changed lines with your editor. Check parentheses, commas, and quotation marks. Indent a loop or function body four spaces.

steps.title: Turn one corner
steps.instruction: Type the changed lines, then press Run. Keep the rest of your working code.
steps.explain: left(90) turns a quarter of a full turn. It changes direction without drawing.
steps.question: Which command makes the corner?
steps.answer: left(90). The next forward command draws upward.
